issues.title: Conflicting DDL Dialects
issues.why: The module provides both SQLite (PascalCase) and PostgreSQL (snake_case/UUID) schemas. While AC-ADB-11 designates SQLite as primary, having two full schemas in one file increases the risk of a mediocre AI picking the wrong dialect or mixing naming conventions.
issues.fix: Move the PostgreSQL 'Reference' DDL to a separate file (e.g., 96-postgres-reference.md) to prevent context-window confusion.

issues.title: Missing Canonicalization Examples
issues.why: The resolution algorithm (Step 1) requires a specific canonicalization pipeline (lowercase, strip .git, etc.), but no worked examples of input vs. output URLs are provided.
issues.fix: Add a table of 5-6 example URL transformations (SSH, HTTPS, trailing slashes) to the Normative Resolution section.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency Guidance
issues.why: SQLite 'busy_timeout' is mentioned via cross-reference to spec/05, but not explicitly defined for the App resolution queries which are high-frequency.
issues.fix: Add a 'Concurrency' note to the Query Patterns section specifying a 5000ms busy_timeout for the App resolver.
